feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 August 2026 4:42pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 28 August 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centre to the east of Scotland, with another low centre moving eastwards into southwest England tomorrow.


##Wind##

Westerly 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east and north, falling variable 2 to 4 in all waters tonight. Settling mainly easterly tomorrow morning, then northerly late afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the south tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in any rain and drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North 2 to 4, backing west or southwest overnight into Sunday, becoming south 3 to 5 through Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle, then showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or showers.
